hero.title: Share Your Cooking Class With Friends
hero.body: Tell your friends about your Balinese cooking class experience. A short message is already written for you below.

shareButtons.shareMessage: I just joined the Balinese cooking class at Raja Bali in Nusa Dua! Hands-on, fun, and delicious. Highly recommend it if you are in Bali!
shareButtons.igNote: Message copied, open Instagram and paste it into a DM, Story, or your bio.
